item.description: VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / November 12, 2026 / ("Amarc" or the "Company") (TSXV:AHR)(OTCQB:AXREF)(FSE:AQ5) is pleased to announce that AuRORA Minerals Ltd, ("AML"), a private joint venture company owned 60% by Freeport-McMoRan Mineral Properties Canada Inc. ("Freeport") and 40% by Amarc, has successfully completed its 2026 exploration program at the JOY District ("JOY" or "District") in the Toodoggone Region of north-central British Columbia ("BC").
item.title: Amarc and Freeport Successfully Complete 2026 Joy Copper-Gold District Exploration Program
